page.layout: One page of text, single column, with Hebrew, Syriac and Chaldee words inline; running head at top; page number top right; no margin notes.

main_text.p: [Hebrew] Ch. Denigrari, nigrescere, [Hebrew] Cutis mea denigrata est, Heb. [Hebrew], Jobi 30.30.
[Hebrew] Ch. Niger, Ater, Genes. 30.32.33. & cap. 2.7. in Targ. Jon. Plur. [Hebrew] Qui nigri, tetri sunt, Jobi 6.16.

[Hebrew] Ch. & Syr. Calere, calidum esse vel fieri, calefieri, incalescere, calefacere se. Pahel [Hebrew] Calefacere, calefaciendo fovere, pullos sc. Jerem. 17.11. Ithpah [Hebrew] Calefieri, calefacere, se, Jobi 31.21, Deut. 22.11. in Jonath.
[Hebrew] Chal. Inflammatio, ulcus calidum, apostema. Hinc Syr. in Plur. [Hebrew] Percussus ulceribus, Lucae 16.20.
[Hebrew] Ch. Calidus. Plur. [Hebrew] Vestimenta tua calida, Jobi 37.17.
[Hebrew] Ch. Serpere, gradi, gradatim incedere, Levit. 11.42. in Targ. sec. Eccles. 1.5.
[Hebrew] Chal. Species avis immundae. Juxta quosdam Æsalon, juxta alios Larus, Lev. 11.16. Hebr. [Hebrew].
[Hebrew] Chal. Tabes, Phtisis, Hebr. [Hebrew] Levit. 26.16. Deut. 28.22. Jon. habet [Hebrew] & [Hebrew].
[Hebrew] Chald. & Syr. Contundere, comminuere, conterere, atterere.
[Hebrew] Chal. Attrita, detrita vestimenta, Jerem. 38.11. & masc. cum aff. [Hebrew] & detritarum suarum vestium non recordentur, Prov. 31.7.
[Hebrew] Chald. Attritio, vetustas, vestimenti pars vetus

page.notes: Hebrew, Syriac and Chaldee words are rendered as [Hebrew] placeholders here because they could not be transcribed letter by letter with confidence; the Latin text is copied as printed. The final word "vetus" sits at the right edge, apparently a catchword-like continuation, and is kept in the text.
